title: Ao Abbas E Dilawar
body:
Di sadaa shah ne tadap kar
Aao abbas- e-dilawar aao abbas dilawar.
Mai Akela hoon beradar aao abbas e dilawar...
1) Mai Leeni me ghira hoon
Kisko maida'n me pukaru'n (2)
Ab Kaha'n hai Mera Lashkar
Aao abbas e dilawar
Bhai Abbas e dilwar
Aao abbas e dilawar
2) Pyase bacho'n Ka tadapna
Mujh se Dekha nahi jata (2)
Hai khayamat Ka ye Manzar.
Aao abbas e dilawar
Bhai Abbas e dilwar
Aao abbas e dilawar
3) Churd Kar Bhai ko tanha
Sogaye tum lab e Dariya (2)
Apne hathon ko Kata Kar
Aao abbas e dilawar
Bhai Abbas e dilwar
Aao abbas e dilawar
4) Mera che Maah ka bacha
Sah shabo Rooz Ka pyasa (2)
Haye mara gaya asger
Aao abbas e dilawar
Bhai Abbas e dilwar
Aao abbas e dilawar
5) Kitne laashe my uthau.n
Our kis kis pe my Roou'n (2)
Lut gaya mera bhara ghar
Aao abbas e dilawar
Bhai Abbas e dilwar
Aao abbas e dilawar
6) Mere khaime bhi jalenge
Haath zainab ke bandhenge (2)
Sar se chin jayegi chadar
Aao abbas e dilawar
Bhai Abbas e dilwar
Aao abbas e dilawar
7) Dur sakeena ke chinenge
Our tamache bhi lagenga (2)
Chain payegi na dam bhar
Aao abbas e dilawar
Bhai Abbas e dilwar
Aao abbas e dilawar
8) Qbr e abbas pa giryaa
Hy Mujeeb apna wazeefa (2)
Tha Jarrey ki a zaba.n par
Aao abbas e dilawar
Bhai Abbas e dilawar
Aao abbas e dilawar
